dct_description_sm: Shows ward and district boundaries.; Ward boundaries and numbers are printed on base map. District boundaries are hand-drawn and districts are hand-numbered in blue pencil.; 29th District includes a portion of the Town of St. Anthony.; "By Swanson, City Clerk. Mar. 9, 1938." Marked in pencil below title area of map recto.; "1700 / 0-4." Marked in pencil at all corners of map sheet.; "#379." Marked in ink at upper left corner of map verso, with "369" crossed out.
85 x 50 centimeters, on sheet 89 x 55 centimeters
